_about: skkumap buildings and spaces as the building sync stores them, exported 2026-10-24 by the skkuverse-crawler session's place-resolver prototype (its data/buildings.json and data/spaces.json). Trimmed to the fields the place index reads: buildings as [skkuId, buildNo, campus, name.ko], spaces as [spaceCd, buildNo, campus], and buildingName.ko once per buildNo. No user data.
